name: deck
description: A row per subagent and workflow agent, Pixel Clawd in a costume for its model, with running, finished and failed counts, time and a memory warning from 70% (/deck details adds cost, requests, tokens processed and memory), and a dithered progress band above the prompt while they run.

autoOpen.title: Open the deck when the first agent starts
autoOpen.description: Opens the pane once per session, when the first subagent or workflow agent starts. /deck pane opens it any time.

subagentCacheTtl.title: Subagent prompt cache lifetime
subagentCacheTtl.description: Prices cache writes at 1.25x input for 5m (the Claude Code default for subagents) or 2x for 1h.
